milestone: A59 named by-reference Generator array spread with an outer reference cell and scalar aliases
scope: A named by-reference Generator yields a real ordinary global-bound array cell containing defined scalar reference leaves. Spread dereferences the outer cell into a DIRECT copied row; later outer-cell rebinding leaves the copied row intact while inner aliases remain shared. A retained old row exposes COW singleton-reference unwrapping after the outside leaf alias is removed. A borrowed Aggregate getter may return the same named Generator. A supplied body throw retires the outer cell at DATA/storage release before canceling the builder-held old row and inner leaf.

Old successes and new old-validator-eps admission are disjoint. The builder uses saved producer history after outer-cell retirement; no stale cache pointer is treated as an owner. By-value and temporary-by-value yields, key/resume/release, generic ownership and schema are unchanged. Owning/special cells, objects, cycles, debt, manual methods and wider producer forms remain partial.
